o: When the Goodways and Chickaletta visit Dino Island, they meet Rex, the resident dinosaur expert who offers to take them on a tour – unfortunately they learn that dinosaurs are afraid of chickens!

eps.o: Before Chickaletta's playdate with Baby Yukiko, Mayor Goodway baby-proofs the playground, wrapping everything in rubbery Snap-N-Wrap - and gets stuck!

eps.t: Pups Save Helga and the Dingers
eps.o: When Mayor Humdinger loses his voice on the day of the Annual Adventure Bay Sing-Off, a competition to find the best singer in town, someone else steps up to replace him.
Things go wrong for Mr. Porter and Winnie Winnington at the orienteering relay in Yellowbone National Park.
Mayor Goodway invites her friend Helga Humdinger, and her rival Mayor Humdinger, to City Hall for afternoon tea.
Cap'n Turbot tells the tale of how he learned to speak fluent "alien" while shipwrecked with an Alien Grandpa!
A lemon-loving baby duckling from Yumi's Farm gets mixed up in a delivery to Lizzy's Lemonade Shoppe.
Mayor Humdinger turns up the power on his robotic soccer cleats, the 'Hum-Kickers', and starts wrecking the town!
Francois causes musical mayhem, as a one-man band, when he plans a special song for Wally's birthday.

eps.t: Air Rescue: Pups Save the Mother Tree
eps.o: In the jungle, Tracker and Lucita Buena call on the Air Rescue Pups to help save an irreplaceable Mother Tree.

eps.t: Pups Save the Ice Cream Truck
eps.o: When the freezer in Mr. Porter's new Ice Cream Truck breaks, it's up to the PAW Patrol to fix the freezer before everything melts!
After stowing away on the Turbots' camping trip, Wally the walrus gets stuck in a mountain crevasse! It's up to Everest and the PAW Patrol to rescue him.

eps.t: Pups Save a DJ in a Jam
eps.o: Mayor Humdinger challenges Rubble for the right to deejay a dance party on Jake's Mountain.

eps.t: Pups and the Digi Tal Safety Suit
eps.o: After Danny's baseball accident, Digi and Tal create a bouncy safety suit for him to wear. But when Danny bounces away, the PAW Patrol have to find him.

eps.t: Pups Put a Mouse on the Move
eps.o: Francois' fancy fromage goes missing before the cheese competition, and with Chase's nose plagued by allergies, he enlists Squeak the mouse to lead the rescue!
Francois builds a person-sized solar system attraction to celebrate the appearance of a shooting star. But when the remote control goes haywire, it sends the attraction soaring.
Lizzy returns from Adventure City with a priceless family heirloom. But when her bag gets mixed up with Danny's stunt bag, the PAW Patrol need to find him and swap the cases before Danny gets hurt.

eps.t: Fire Rescue: Pups and the Missing Water Mystery
eps.o: When Mr. Park's rooftop garden accidentally catches fire, the Fire Rescue Pups make a terrible discovery: there's no water in Adventure Bay! Marshall and Skye go in search of a solution to the missing water mystery before the flames start to spread.
A trio of mischievous squirrels have concocted a plan to take over Jake's cozy mountain cabin. Now it's up to Everest and the pups to rescue Jake and find a way to get his home back.
